results.content: CISCE Board Exams 2026 LIVE: ISC Class 12 Biology question paper analysis; answer key, updates. Established in 1958, the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE) conducts the ISC or class 12th exams in schools that are affiliated with the council. * Students should work hard and complete the CISCE board Class 12 syllabus 2026 before the commencement of the exams, and they should practice with ISC question papers of previous years to get acquainted with the exam pattern over the years. * Students whose ISC 12th application forms are accepted by the Board will be issued admit cards for appearing in the exam. * Students should solve the ISC specimen question papers and previous year ISC 12th question papers to understand the exam pattern, marking scheme, frequently asked questions, etc, in a better way.
